newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Kwong Sang Hong up ahead of interim result.
newsitem.headline: Kwong Sang Hong up ahead of interim result.

text.p: Shares of property concern Kwong Sang Hong International Ltd rose on speculative buying ahead of the release of its interim results due on Thursday, brokers said on Tuesday.

"Anticipation of a pick up in earnings fueled demand," a senior sale manager at a regional brokerage. "The recent wave of demand for property stocks on speculation of stronger earnings in view of recent good flats sales response also aided demand."
The company's shares rose HK$0.10 or 3.92 percent to a session high of HK$2.65 before steadying at HK$2.625 at midday. Volume was 3.46 million shares worth HK$9.09 million.

Analysts said they expected Kwong Sang Hong to achieve an about 10 percent growth in earnings for the first half of 1996. The company posted a 47.4 percent drop in interim profit to HK$68.28 million the same period a year ago.
